title: Finite Tor over the base gives finite projective dimension over a localized polynomial ring
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring, n ∈ ℕ, p a prime of R = A[t₁,...,tₙ], S = R_p, and M a finite S-module. Regard M as an A-module through A → R → S. Suppose d ∈ ℕ satisfies Tor_i^A(M,N) = 0 for every A-module N and i > d [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], with the first-variable Tor convention. Then there exists k ∈ ℕ with HasProjectiveDimensionLE M k, meaning Ext_S^i(M,N) = 0 for every S-module N and i ≥ k+1 [def-pc-ext, def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. The zero module and n = 0 are included.

source.place: Tag 068X, Lemma 15.79.5, applied to a finite module concentrated in degree zero; source read online

proof.text: Obtain the localized Tor bound d+n from lem-pc-localized-polynomial-tor-bound. The polynomial ring and its localization are Noetherian by Mathlib. Apply lem-pc-finite-projective-dimension-of-tor-bound at d+n, then introduce that natural bound in the existential conclusion.

theorem localizedPolynomial_finiteProjectiveDimension_of_finiteTor
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (n : ℕ) (p : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl))
    [Module.Finite (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) M]
    (d : ℕ)
    (hTor : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} A, ∀ i : ℕ, d < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)).comp MvPolynomial.C)).obj M)).obj N)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, HasProjectiveDimensionLE M k
